name: Chungsong Bridge
facts: Opened September 6, 1983, the Chungsong Bridge became Pyongyang's westernmost major road crossing, linking the bustling Pyongchon District with the industrial Rangrang District across the Taedong River.
Designed with two lanes each way plus a dedicated tram track, the Chungsong Bridge also features pedestrian walkways on both sides, blending transport efficiency with commuter convenience.
Midway, the bridge hosts on‑ and off‑ramps to Ssuk Island, home of the Pyongyang Sci‑Tech Complex, and provides access to the larger, agriculturally focused Turu Island.
